articles.summary: LATAM reported revenues of US$4.6 billion, an increase of 18.4%, and an adjusted operating margin of 12.5%, amid a sharp rise in fuel prices. Santiago, November 3, 2026 LATAM Airlines Group announced its financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting net income of US$441 million, up 16.3% compared to the same quarter of the previous year. Operating revenues reached US$4.6 billion, an 18.4% increase compared to the third quarter of 2025, while adjusted EBITDA totaled US$1.1 billion. Adjusted operating income reached US$573 million, representing an adjusted operating margin of 12.5%, compared to 18.1% in the third quarter of 2025. During the period, LATAM faced higher fuel costs, with average fuel prices increasing 52.1% compared to the same period last year, resulting in an impact of approximately US$520 million.
